warnings: Roof framing of the two side blocks (bays 1-3 and 6-8); the centre block (bays 3-6) is marked โล่ง here and framed on S-06 at +5.80.

The ring beams printed on this sheet at +3.10 (row A all bays; row C bays 3-6) are the SAME beams already drawn on the mezzanine plan S-04 at +3.10 — not repeated here, to avoid double counting. Only members new to this sheet are recorded: row-C beams B6 +4.52 in bays 1-3 / 6-8, the gable beams B12 on grids 3 and 6, the two ดั้ง คสล. and the steel gutter-ridge.

The gutter-ridge (อกไก่เหล็ก รางน้ำ 2-150x75x75x4.5) runs along the line printed '~1.77' above row C (B', 4.23), from grid 1 to 3 and 6 to 8; it is split at the grids. Its section prints four numbers that do not fit a d x b x tw x tf channel; only d/b parsed, print kept.

Rafters and purlins are steel C-sections with no mark (element_id null, element_name_assigned). On this scan the rafter lines cannot be told apart from the beam/grid lines reliably, so rafters and purlins are recorded as spacing/area elements, not counted.
B12 carries no level on the plan; its detail on S-06 shows it as a sloped gable beam (กลางจั่ว) sitting on B7.
